LESSON: GUIDED WRITING

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: MANDARIN
Strand: Writing 3.2 Guided Writing (1 lesson) Mechanics of writing (word order and punct
Topic 3.3: Guided Writing
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 1

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Guided Writing, part of Writing 3.2 Guided Writing (1 lesson) Mechanics of writing (word order and punct in Grade 5 MANDARIN.

Key inquiry question: How do you improve your descriptive writing skills?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen to a recording and place the correct tone on the words and phrases given (ˉ ˊ ˇ ˋ 和 轻声),

2. work together to look at pictures/models of classroom items and label them correctly (e.g.铅笔 qiānbǐ、橡皮 xiàngpí 、尺子 chǐzi、书 shū、黑板 hēibǎn etc.),

3. circle the correct names of colours in a word search with peers (e.g. 红色 hóng sè、蓝色 lán sè、黄色 huáng sè、绿色 lǜ sè、橙色 chéng sè、黑色 hēi sè、白色 bái sè etc.),

4. use the given pictures to write simple descriptions on the colours of classroom items (e.g. Zhè shì hóngsè de bǐ; Wǒ de bāo shì hēisè de.),

5. create a mood board with descriptions about the colour of items found in their classroom,

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen to a recording and place the correct tone on the words and phrases given (ˉ ˊ ˇ ˋ 和 轻声),
2. work together to look at pictures/models of classroom items and label them correctly (e.g.铅笔 qiānbǐ、橡皮 xiàngpí 、尺子 chǐzi、书 shū、黑板 hēibǎn etc.),
3. circle the correct names of colours in a word search with peers (e.g. 红色 hóng sè、蓝色 lán sè、黄色 huáng sè、绿色 lǜ sè、橙色 chéng sè、黑色 hēi sè、白色 bái sè etc.),
4. use the given pictures to write simple descriptions on the colours of classroom items (e.g. Zhè shì hóngsè de bǐ; Wǒ de bāo shì hēisè de.),
5. create a mood board with descriptions about the colour of items found in their classroom,

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Guided Writing together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Communication and Collaboration: The learner writes clearly and spells words correctly as they label classroom items

with peers.

• Learning to learn: Self-discipline is enhanced as the learner works collaboratively to combine colours and labels

them correctly in Chinese.

Values:
Integrity: The learner exhibits self-discipline as they create a mood board with descriptions about colours of classroom items.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Social cohesion: This is developed as the learner works jointly and mutually with peers to identify the correct names of

colours from a word puzzle.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner links the concept of creative presentation of one’s work to their learning in Creative Arts.
